title: 第三章 撒娇变成原形的阿宝
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“皇姐。”

阿宝小心翼翼地观察着枫溪的态度，小声地说着，“这不像是你的风格。”

在见到枫溪亲吻着白玥的那一刻，阿宝都惊呆了。

他那个瞬间连话都说不清楚了。

他沉默了，只能用震惊的眼神看着这一幕。

他觉得自己的认知受到了限制。

不愧是皇姐，他压根捉摸不透对方的想法。

“是么？这不重要，重要的是我们这有着人类血脉的姐姐很害羞。”

“哈哈。”

枫溪的眼眸闪烁着少许的笑意，“好像一朵易碎的玉簪花，洁白无瑕的等着别人去染黑。”

“我是一个魔女，当然不介意做这种坏事。”

枫溪勾唇一笑，“好欺负，那就往死里欺负。”

“而且，她还有了一个巨大的软肋。”

“她的孩子。”

一想到自己说到那个孩子的时候，白玥那复杂且恐惧的眼神，枫溪只觉得自己的心情特别美好。

别人不开心就对了。

她要的就是别人不开心自己开心。

毕竟，笑容不会消失，只会转移。

从别人的身上转移到自己的脸上，那是一件很有成就感的事情。

枫溪唇角微微上扬，她的脸上洋溢着淡淡的笑容。

她不笑还好，这一笑让阿宝毛骨悚然。

他的心中生出冰冷的想法来。

他的二皇姐在见到大皇姐之后变成一个变态了！

他有点害怕，可以逃跑么？

阿宝弱弱地想着。

貌似，他好像跑不掉。

毕竟，谁让眼前突然变的变态的人是他一母同胞的亲姐姐。

他们的身上流淌着相同的血液。

他就算再嫌弃也得跟对方在一块。

谁让他们是亲姐弟。

枫溪沉浸在自己的情感之中，并未注意到阿宝的那些复杂想法。

不然，她肯定要把阿宝暴揍一顿。

她那么高傲、漂亮、心胸宽广的魔女，当然不是变态了！

谁说她是变态，那一定是对方的审美和认知有问题！

她一定要狠狠地收拾对方，打的爹娘都不认识的那种。

她可是高高在上的魔女，不屑放低身段跟他们对话。

"Sister Royal."

Abao carefully observed Fengxi's attitude and whispered, "This doesn't seem like your style."

The moment he saw Fengxi kissing Bai Yue, Abao was shocked.

He couldn't even speak clearly at that moment.

He was silent and could only look at this scene with shocked eyes.

He felt that his knowledge was limited.

As expected of the imperial sister, he couldn't figure out what the other party was thinking.

"Really? That's not important. What's important is that our sister with human blood is very shy."

"Haha."

Fengxi's eyes flashed with a little smile, "It's like a fragile hosta flower, pure and flawless, waiting for others to dye it black."

"I'm a witch, so of course I don't mind doing such bad things."

Fengxi curled her lips and smiled, "It's easy to bully, then bully him to death."

"Besides, she has a huge weakness."

"Her child."

When she thought of Bai Yue's complicated and frightened eyes when she talked about that child, Fengxi felt that she was in a particularly beautiful mood.

It’s okay if others are unhappy.

What she wants is to be happy when others are unhappy.

After all, smiles don’t disappear, they just move.

It is a very fulfilling thing to transfer from other people's body to your own face.

The corners of Fengxi's lips raised slightly, and a faint smile filled her face.

It's okay if she doesn't smile, but this smile makes Abao's hair stand on end.

A cold thought came into his mind.

His second emperor sister turned into a pervert after meeting the eldest emperor sister!

He is a little scared, can he run away?

Abao thought weakly.

It seemed like he couldn't escape.

After all, the person who suddenly became perverted in front of him was his biological sister.

The same blood flows in their bodies.

No matter how much he dislikes him, he still has to be with the other person.

Who makes them siblings?

Fengxi was immersed in his own emotions and did not notice A Bao's complicated thoughts.

Otherwise, she would definitely beat up Abao.

She is such a proud, beautiful, and broad-minded witch, so of course she is not a pervert!

Who says she is a pervert? It must be that there is something wrong with her aesthetics and cognition!

She must deal with the other party so hard that her parents won't even recognize her.

She was a witch who was aloof and didn't bother to lower her stature to talk to them.
